label: live
test: Claude sign-in shows pending progress and resumes polling after a connection error
expected: the Jevellan web app "login recovery" screen at desktop-light, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "Claude sign-in shows pending progress and resumes polling after a connection error"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The dialog title shows a raw UUID ('Login recovery 116b5fe6-6e09-4670-a808-d7f9442ce4b8'), which is long and not user-friendly, but it fits on one line and isn't cut off.

Two status messages appear at once: 'Code sent. Waiting for sign-in to finish…' and the error banner 'Can't reach Jevellan. Try again when it's connected.' This fits the connection-error step but could confuse users.
The 'Open sign-in page' button sits close to the status text below it, so that area feels a bit cramped.
